newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: Luxembourg banking sector reaches labour agreement.
newsitem.headline: Luxembourg banking sector reaches labour agreement.

text.p: The Association of Banks and Bankers of Luxembourg (ABBL) and the umbrella organisation of banking sector unions said late on Monday they had signed a collective labour agreement for 1996-98.
Salaries for bank employees are to rise by a respective 1.7 percent, 1.6 percent and 1.5 percent for 1996, 1997 and 1998, the ABBL said in a statement.
One-off bonuses ranging from 15,000 to 25,000 Luxembourg francs are to be given to employees depending on seniority and individual performance, once the accord has been accepted.
Additional one-off bonuses of 5,000 francs to 10,000 francs are due in June 1998.
Flexibility in working hours will be increased by replacing the present three bank holidays with four days of rest. Each bank is to be allowed to negotiate the time-off dates with its employees.
